newsitem.title: ITALY: New access road to Rome-Fiumincino airport.
newsitem.headline: New access road to Rome-Fiumincino airport.

text.p: A new viaduct opened yesterday to complete an elevated road linking Rome-Fiumincino highway and the national and international flight terminals.

Access to Fiumicino's Leonardo da Vinci airport can now rely on three different lanes that are able to separate the flows of traffic to the airport, to the multi-level car parks, the technical areas and towns of Fiumicino and Ostia, making it easier to enter the airport.
The viaduct road system employeed over 200 workers and required a total investment of Lire 40 billion and stretches 2.5 km.
